sections.content: transform moves, rotates, scales, and skews elements without affecting layout — translate, rotate, scale, skew, and matrix(). transform-origin sets the pivot point.
Unlike margin/position changes, transforms are GPU-composited and smooth — prefer them for animations and hover effects.
Key points: multiple functions chain left-to-right, percentages refer to element size, and 3D transforms need perspective on the parent.
